mapper.select: SELECT sku_id as skuId, product_id as productId, sku_attribute as skuAttribute, sku_value as skuValue, price, stock, min_stock as minStock, sales, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime FROM sku WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY sku_id

SELECT sku_id as skuId, product_id as productId, sku_attribute as skuAttribute, sku_value as skuValue, price, stock, min_stock as minStock, sales, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime FROM sku WHERE sku_id = #{skuId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sku ( product_id, sku_attribute, sku_value, price, stock, min_stock, sales, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{skuAttribute}, #{skuValue}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{minStock}, #{sales}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE sku SET sku_attribute = #{skuAttribute}, sku_value = #{skuValue}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, min_stock = #{minStock}, update_time = NOW() WHERE sku_id = #{skuId}
